title: Friendship ended with Deno, now Node is my best friend
summary: A developer shares their personal journey switching from Deno back to Node.js, discussing practical reasons related to ecosystem maturity, npm compatibility, and development tooling that influenced their decision.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of choosing the right JavaScript runtime when ecosystem support, tooling availability, and practical daily development considerations are factored in.
why_valuable: Provides real-world insights from a developer who experienced both runtimes, offering practical guidance for others evaluating their technology choices.
